required_tests.test_name: contract C01: exact process Repo connection xid request target action context is required
required_tests.assertion: Reject forged Decision/map, foreign or dynamic Repo, other process, wrong target/action, missing marker, stale xid and post-commit/rollback use; zero domain SQL effects.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C02: callback lifecycle failures roll back all local effects
required_tests.assertion: Error, exception, throw, exit, zero/two callbacks, malformed envelope and final-context failure leave artifact event dedup and head unchanged.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C03: time is rechecked after each lock wait and immediately before effects
required_tests.assertion: Token, credential, family and selected membership expire during a barrier-controlled wait; no write or cached/private result escapes.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C04: revocation ordering holds for all six canonical lock classes
required_tests.assertion: For each class prove admitted shared-lock request finishes before revocation succeeds; inverse ordering reads committed revocation and denies.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C05: complete post-lock authorization snapshot is truthful
required_tests.assertion: Observe profile/binding revisions, separate family/credential windows, selected membership tuples, head revisions, iat/exp and exact target; no fabricated auth_time.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C06: queue lock and transaction deadlines fail closed without leaked context
required_tests.assertion: Saturate checkout queue, exceed 500ms lock wait and 5s bounded transaction; reuse same connection after each and observe no remaining context.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C07: first upload commits one coherent immutable artifact event dedup and head
required_tests.assertion: 201 created; exact envelope signed bytes CBOR signature payload hashes normalized ancestry event and principal result are consistent after reconnect.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C08: same principal key request returns original success across refreshed credentials
required_tests.assertion: Concurrent retries and post-restart retry yield original status event and actor; exactly one initial artifact event dedup sequence.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C09: different principal cannot recover tenant key cached result
required_tests.assertion: Currently eligible second principal receives idempotency_conflict with no original body/actor disclosure; no new row or sequence.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C10: same key changed request conflicts
required_tests.assertion: Vary exact envelope whitespace, reason, target, action, platform and runtime independently; no second side effect.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C11: new key identical content preserves Go v3 duplicate semantics
required_tests.assertion: 200 unchanged with one new event and principal result; artifact exact bytes and creating event immutable; previous_state equals current_state.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C12: new key formatting-only change retains first exact bytes
required_tests.assertion: Semantically identical canonical manifest signature and payload return 200 unchanged; new event binds request envelope hash; stored first envelope remains exact.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C13: same manifest changed immutable content conflicts
required_tests.assertion: Changed signature or payload with matching reference cannot overwrite; rejection occurs at admission or immutable_conflict as applicable and leaves no successful row.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C14: revoked actor cannot read a cached idempotent success
required_tests.assertion: Revoke profile binding principal family credential or membership before retry; authorization rejection precedes dedup response.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C15: project mutation head serializes concurrent distinct commands
required_tests.assertion: Barrier-controlled same-project uploads allocate contiguous sequences and valid edges; different tenants never share a head/event or retry key.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C16: failure injection preserves all or nothing
required_tests.assertion: Inject failure after artifact insert event insert dedup insert and head update; reconnect and prove rollback of every effect at each boundary.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C17: ambiguous commit is reconciled by the same principal key
required_tests.assertion: Fault after actual commit reports storage unavailable; fresh eligible retry returns single original committed success; fault before commit retries once.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C18: database invariants reject forged standalone writes
required_tests.assertion: Restricted runtime SQL attempts event without artifact/dedup, head alone, gap, bad predecessor/state, changed digest/projection/bytes and cross-tenant FK; none commit.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C19: domain records are immutable through every privilege path
required_tests.assertion: Runtime UPDATE DELETE TRUNCATE REFERENCES TRIGGER grants, writable views and unsafe helper overloads are rejected; only intended head columns writable.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C20: topology rejects reachable privilege and unsafe schema owners
required_tests.assertion: Current/session mismatch, table/helper owner membership, each reachable pg_ or elevated role, indirect NOINHERIT, public schema CREATE, public execution and missing FORCE RLS fail unavailable.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C21: scoped row policy rejects absent forged foreign or expired context
required_tests.assertion: Probe every new table by restricted runtime using missing/wrong action target tenant principal and expired state; no private rows or effects.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C22: scope projections match retained signed manifest ancestry
required_tests.assertion: Independently corrupt organization project app environment platform runtime digest and payload projections; authorization/read or commit fails closed.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C23: missing head and sequence exhaustion fail without partial effects
required_tests.assertion: No implicit unlocked head creation; missing head and maximum next-sequence overflow leave zero domain writes.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C24: v2 event accepts current text IDs and truthful token times
required_tests.assertion: Non-UUID bounded internal IDs and token iat older than 45s remain representable; event reconstructs exact CBOR and domain hash.
required_tests.environment: pure Elixir codec plus independently generated expected vectors

required_tests.test_name: contract C25: v2 snapshot closed types order bounds and windows reject malformed data
required_tests.assertion: Unknown/missing fields, wrong type, duplicate/unsorted memberships, disallowed role, mismatched scope, invalid window and all length boundaries reject before encoding.
required_tests.environment: pure Elixir codec plus independently generated expected vectors

required_tests.test_name: contract C26: v2 hashes bind exact actor decision outcome target and request
required_tests.assertion: Mutate every field and required row projection independently; exact expected rejection or hash change; no v1 decoder/schema fallback.
required_tests.environment: pure Elixir codec plus independently generated expected vectors

required_tests.test_name: contract C27: independent vectors prove canonical bytes and predecessor state rules
required_tests.assertion: Independently encode initial created, unchanged and later created events; compare bytes and hashes; gaps foreign predecessors and changed state edge reject.
required_tests.environment: pure Elixir codec plus independently generated expected vectors

required_tests.test_name: contract C28: v1 audit source bytes tests and historical hashes are preserved
required_tests.assertion: Existing UploadEvent tests still pass with unchanged input/source baseline; historical v1 rows never gain v2 actor/principal ownership.
required_tests.environment: pure Elixir codec plus independently generated expected vectors

required_tests.test_name: contract C29: metadata resolver derives target without guessed environment
required_tests.assertion: Route has tenant and digest only; resolver returns no payload; derive app/environment/platform/runtime from immutable stored manifest then exact artifact.read check.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C30: private read rechecks target authorization trust and exact retained bytes
required_tests.assertion: Foreign guessed app/env cannot redirect authorization; revoked/expired roots or altered stored bytes fail closed; authorized response equals first stored envelope exactly.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C31: read revocation and membership expiry obey lock ordering
required_tests.assertion: Run both orderings for all applicable state/head locks and expire credential/member during wait; no unauthorized private byte return.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C32: private and audit read contexts are action specific
required_tests.assertion: Project audit.read cannot fetch artifact/private dedup; artifact.read cannot query audit; no visible project is not_found; supported insufficient scope is permission_denied.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C33: audit pages are bounded ordered and verify predecessor edges
required_tests.assertion: after_sequence/limit boundaries, empty page, tenant isolation, corrupt predecessor/CBOR/display and 100-event page all checked; no upload-chain mutation on reads.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C34: audit actor remains immutable across lifecycle edits
required_tests.assertion: Rename/disable/revision change and refreshed credential retry cannot alter original v2 actor or event; baseline profile/binding revision 1 makes no historical revision claim.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection

required_tests.test_name: contract C35: retained resource bounds are exact and no external work executes
required_tests.assertion: Exact/one-over envelope signed CBOR payload reason key snapshot bounds checked; instrument callback to prove no network provider signer job or publication action occurs.
required_tests.environment: disposable real PostgreSQL with non-owner restricted runtime and independent provisioning connection
